subject: Língua Portuguesa
description_pt: Planejar e produzir cartas pessoais e diários, com expressão de sentimentos e opiniões, dentre outros gêneros do campo da vida cotidiana, de acordo com as convenções dos gêneros carta e diário e considerando a situação comunicativa e o tema/assunto do texto.

components.description_pt: Planejar uma carta pessoal ou diário considerando a situação comunicativa e o tema
components.description_en: Plan a personal letter or diary entry considering the communicative situation and topic
components.cc_component_description: Plan writing by considering purpose, audience, and the most significant ideas to convey

components.description_pt: Produzir uma carta pessoal seguindo as convenções estruturais do gênero carta
components.description_en: Produce a personal letter following the structural conventions of the letter genre
components.cc_component_description: Apply discipline-specific conventions of style in academic or technical writing

components.description_pt: Produzir um diário seguindo as convenções estruturais do gênero diário
components.description_en: Produce a diary entry following the structural conventions of the diary genre
components.cc_component_description: Apply discipline-specific conventions of style in academic or technical writing

components.description_pt: Expressar sentimentos e opiniões apropriadamente em cartas pessoais e diários
components.description_en: Express feelings and opinions appropriately in personal letters and diary entries
components.cc_component_description: Express personal feelings clearly when speaking about an experience or event

cc_matches.description: Establish and maintain a formal style and objective tone while attending to the norms and conventions of the discipline in which they are writing.
Describe people, places, things, and events with relevant details, expressing ideas and feelings clearly.
Develop and strengthen writing as needed by planning, revising, editing, rewriting, or trying a new approach, focusing on addressing what is most significant for a specific purpose and audience.
